item.title: Advice On The Silent Disease Osteoporosis
item.description: Osteoporosis is often called the ‘silent disease’ because many people don’t realise they have it until a fracture occurs. With up to half a million Irish adults affected, maintaining bone strength and balance as we age is more important than ever.
